preconditions.description: Number of vertices is within the specified range.
Number of edges is within the specified range.
Number of queries is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each initial value on a vertex is within the range [1, n].
All initial values on vertices are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(query_type in ['1', '2'] for query_type, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query type is either '1' or '2'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for query_type, v in queries if query_type == '1')
preconditions.description: In a type '1' query, the vertex v is within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= m for query_type, i in queries if query_type == '2')
preconditions.description: In a type '2' query, the edge i is within the range [1, m].

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == max(p[u] for u in reachable_vertices(v, graph)) for i, (query_type, v) in enumerate(queries) if query_type == '1')
postconditions.description: For each type '1' query, the output is the maximum value among all reachable vertices from v.

postconditions.expression: all(graph[i] == None for i, (query_type, i) in enumerate(queries) if query_type == '2')
postconditions.description: After a type '2' query, the corresponding edge is removed from the graph.

invariants.expression: all(0 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
invariants.description: Each vertex value is within the range [0, n].

invariants.expression: all(graph[i] != None for i in range(m) if i not in deleted_edges)
invariants.description: An edge is present in the graph if it has not been deleted.
